Name: Simple Crop and Artisan Good Harvest Multiplier
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]✦ Simple Crop and Artisan Goods Harvest Multiplier ✦[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#FDE68A][b]💡 Requested Mod[/b] — suggested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45]Harold45[/url] on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53712?tab=posts]Simple Crop Reseed posts page[/url].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Choose how often crop harvests and collected artisan goods receive extra quantities, with independent settings for each group.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🌾 What It Does[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• [b]Crops:[/b] standard hand/scythe harvests, regrowing and trellis crops, and Junimo collection.
• [b]Artisan goods:[/b] standard collection from kegs, preserves jars, bee houses, mayonnaise/cheese makers, looms, oil makers and casks.
• Keeps item quality, colour, flavour and custom properties. Extra items enter your backpack; overflow remains collectible at the harvest or machine. Junimo extras go to the hut.
• Failed collections grant no bonus. Partial collections multiply only the quantity received.
• Settings text is included in English and all eleven other built-in game languages.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙ Choose Your Multipliers[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Each group has its own settings:[/b]
Chance: [b]0–100%[/b] · Minimum: [b]1–100×[/b] · Maximum: [b]1–200×[/b]

[b]Defaults are 100% chance and 1× minimum/maximum:[/b] quantities stay normal until you configure them. Set both multipliers to 2 for a fixed 2× yield. Set chance to 0% to disable one group. A maximum below the minimum is raised to match it.

[b]Example:[/b] 25% chance with a 2–4× range gives each successful harvest a 25% chance for two to four times its collected output. Bonuses delivered during the same supported harvest are included. Growth, machine timing and native harvest XP stay unchanged.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🔗 Compatibility & Scope[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]PC single-player.[/b] Multipliers are disabled in multiplayer and split-screen.
Data-driven custom crops and artisan-category products using standard collection paths are eligible. Automate and custom automated collection are not integrated in 1.0; mods that replace harvesting need individual checks.
Giant crops, fruit trees, ordinary forage pickups, ginger digging, quest items and crop byproducts such as seeds/hay are excluded.
Unusually large custom harvests are limited to 100,000 bonus items and 256 bonus stacks per collection.
Local native tests include Crop Reseed 1.2 coexistence; live full-modpack testing remains.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🛠 Requirements & Install[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0+[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional for in-game settings. Without it, edit config.json after running the game once.
Extract [b]SimpleHarvestMultiplier[/b] into your Mods folder. Crop Reseed is not required.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please share reports and ideas on this mod’s page.
[b]Bugs:[/b] include the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, expected versus actual behavior, reproduction steps, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if helpful.
[b]Suggestions:[/b] tell me what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
